description: Import company records into accounts WITH validation, duplicate matching, provenance and a log. PREVIEW BY DEFAULT: nothing is written unless commit=true — a batch import is the change where one mistake hits two hundred rows, not one. Preview and real run take the same path and produce the same log, so what you review is what will happen. Duplicates are matched on register number + court, then VAT id, then normalised name — and a NAME match never merges by itself: same-named companies in different towns are common, and un-merging two companies afterwards is hand work across every record. An existing, non-empty field is never overwritten silently; it is reported as a difference. Bad rows do not stop the run, they land in the log with a reason. Accepts rows (array) or csv (text with a header line).

commit.description: true actually writes. Default false = preview.

csv.description: Alternative to rows: CSV with a header line. Separator ; or ,

merge_suggestions.description: true also merges UNCERTAIN (name-only) matches. Off by default, and think twice: that is the setting that merges two different companies.

rows.description: Company records: name (required), legal_form, register_number, register_court, vat_id, address, postal_code, city, country, website, representatives[].

source.description: Where this came from — appears in the log and in each field's provenance. E.g. 'handelsregister', 'csv:kundenliste-2026'.

name: import_organisations
